sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: When you own a home, water is your greatest enemy.
sentences.zh: 当你拥有自己的房子时，水就是你最大的敌人。

sentences.en: So much work is put into keeping water from coming in,
sentences.zh: 我们花了大量的工作来防止水渗入室内，

sentences.en: and so much engineering is built into getting whatever water that inevitably seeps in
sentences.zh: 并且运用了大量的工程设计，把不可避免渗入室内的水

sentences.en: back out again before it pools and causes rot.
sentences.zh: 在它积聚并引起腐烂之前排出去。

sentences.en: This is one of the reasons why I am so fascinated by the houseboats of Sausalito, California,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我如此着迷于加州索萨利托的船屋的原因之一，

sentences.en: which seem to tempt fate with their very existence.
sentences.zh: 它们的存在本身似乎就是在向命运发起挑战。

sentences.en: The floating homes that fill up and spill out past the docks of this Marin County town
sentences.zh: 这些停泊在马林县这个小镇的码头边、并向外延伸密密麻麻的浮动房屋

sentences.en: started appearing at the turn of the 20th century.
But it was during World War II, when tens of thousands of people flooded into the area to work in the shipyards,
sentences.zh: 但在二战期间，成千上万的人涌入该地区在造船厂工作，

sentences.en: that the real housing boom along the Sausalito waterfront began.
sentences.zh: 索萨利托海滨真正的住房热潮才由此开始。

sentences.en: Housing was scarce, and workers made homes out of old boats and any other materials they could scrounge.
sentences.zh: 当时住房极为紧缺，工人们用旧船和他们能搜罗到的任何其他材料搭建房屋。

sentences.en: Today, there's a wide variety of houseboats dotted along the bay.
sentences.zh: 如今，海湾沿岸点缀着各种各样的船屋。

sentences.en: Some are real boats that could unmoor and sail across the sea.
sentences.zh: 有些是真正的船只，可以解缆起锚并航行于大海之上。

sentences.en: But many have no means of locomotion at all, and are just houses on floating pallets.
sentences.zh: 但许多船屋根本没有任何动力装置，只是浮动平台上的房子而已。

sentences.en: Some are multi-story, opulent weekend retreats, and some look decidedly original recipe,
sentences.zh: 有些是多层的、富丽堂皇的周末度假屋，有些则看起来绝对原汁原味，

sentences.en: like they were indeed made out of driftwood during World War II.
sentences.zh: 就像它们真的是在二战期间用漂流木搭建的一样。

sentences.en: When the staff came to the Bay Area for our most recent retreat,
sentences.zh: 当我们的员工来到湾区参加最近的静修活动时，

sentences.en: I took the team kayaking on the bay near the houseboats.
sentences.zh: 我带着团队在船屋附近的海湾划皮划艇。

sentences.en: It is so peaceful, it is one of my favorite activities.
sentences.zh: 那里非常宁静，这是我最喜欢的活动之一。

sentences.en: If you enjoy walking around your neighborhood and wondering about the lives of the people inside,
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢在自己的街区散步，并对屋内人们的生活充满好奇，

sentences.en: kayaking near houseboats is like that on acid.
sentences.zh: 那么在船屋附近划皮划艇就像是吸了毒一样过瘾。

sentences.en: It is such a bold choice of lifestyle, your mind goes wild with possibilities.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常大胆的生活方式选择，让你的思绪在无限的可能中驰骋。

sentences.en: I mostly imagine two types of owners.
sentences.zh: 我脑海中想象的主要是两类业主。

sentences.en: Rich, retired folks who want to be present on the water and ensconced in a weird, tight, bohemian community.
sentences.zh: 富有且退休的老年人，他们希望亲近水面，同时隐居在一个奇特、紧密、充满波西米亚风情的社区里。

sentences.en: And people who have bottomed out and live in the architectural equivalent of steering into the skid.
sentences.zh: 以及那些陷入生活低谷、过着堪称建筑版“迎着侧滑打方向盘”般生活的人。

sentences.en: Living on a houseboat may be a good path or a bad path, but it is most definitely a path.
sentences.zh: 住在船屋上可能是一条好路，也可能是一条坏路，但它绝对是一条路。

sentences.en: In the final episode of our Vernacular Spectacular Anniversary Series,
sentences.zh: 在我们“本土建筑壮观周年系列”的最后一期节目中，

sentences.en: 99PI producers and friends of the show will be sharing more stories of regional architecture,
sentences.zh: 99PI的制作人们和节目的朋友们将分享更多关于地方建筑的故事，

sentences.en: some close to home, some on remote islands,
sentences.zh: 有些离家很近，有些在遥远的岛屿上，

sentences.en: that capture our imagination and inspire us to look deeper.
sentences.zh: 这些故事抓住了我们的想象力，并激励我们做更深入的探索。

sentences.en: Thanks again for joining us, and thanks for getting us to 502 episodes.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢大家的收听，也感谢你们陪伴我们走到第502期节目。

sentences.en: Up first is Digital Director, Kurt Kolstad.

sentences.en: A while back, I opened an email from a 99PI listener located in Bermuda named Amy Daniels,

sentences.en: in which she introduced me to her island's remarkable vernacular architecture.
sentences.zh: 她在邮件中向我介绍了她所在岛屿Remarkable的本土建筑。

sentences.en: So I wrote back to her to find out more,
sentences.zh: 于是我给她回信以了解更多信息，

sentences.en: and the next thing I knew, Amy was introducing me to a local architect.
sentences.zh: 接下来我才知道，艾米正把我介绍给一位当地的建筑师。

sentences.en: I'm a senior architect for OBM in Bermuda.
sentences.zh: 我是百慕大OBM公司的高级建筑师。

sentences.en: OBM is a firm that started in Bermuda over 85 years ago.
sentences.zh: OBM是一家在百慕大创立已有85年以上的公司。

sentences.en: And when I asked Colin how he and Amy knew one another...
sentences.zh: 当我问科林他和艾米是如何认识的时候……
这里是百慕大，大家都是一家人。

sentences.en: Amy had asked her mother, and her mother who scratched her head said,
sentences.zh: 艾米问了她的母亲，她母亲挠了挠头说，

sentences.en: So everything's two degrees of separation.
sentences.zh: 所以所有关系都只有两度分离。

sentences.en: I asked Colin to start out by just telling me about Bermuda,
sentences.zh: 我请科林先简单给我介绍一下百慕大，

sentences.en: which, to be honest, he really sold me on.
sentences.zh: 说实话，他的介绍真的深深打动了我。

sentences.en: Bermuda is a place that, if it hadn't been made, you couldn't dream it up.
sentences.zh: 百慕大是一个如果你没有亲眼见到，绝对梦想不出来的地方。

sentences.en: It's just on the edge of the Gulf Stream.
sentences.zh: 它恰好位于墨西哥湾流的边缘。

sentences.en: So we have a temperate climate, as opposed to a colder North Atlantic climate.
sentences.zh: 因此我们拥有温带气候，而不是寒冷的北大西洋气候。

sentences.en: Colin went on to explain that the first European settlers
sentences.zh: 科林接着解释说，最早的欧洲定居者

sentences.en: arrived on this beautiful island back in the 1600s.
sentences.zh: 早在17世纪就来到了这个美丽的岛屿。

sentences.en: And a lot of their early buildings were wood-framed
sentences.zh: 他们早期的许多建筑都是木结构框架，

sentences.en: and topped off with roofs made of thatched grass.
But, as we all know from the Three Little Pigs,
sentences.zh: 但是，正如我们从《三只小猪》中都知道的那样，

sentences.en: straw and wood aren't the most robust materials.
sentences.zh: 稻草和木头并不是最坚固的材料。

sentences.en: For almost 100 years, people did a stick-and-frame construction,
sentences.zh: 近百年来，人们一直在使用这种木条框架结构，

sentences.en: and then after a couple of hurricanes in 1712, 1714,
sentences.zh: 然后在经历1712年和1714年的几次飓风之后，

sentences.en: a light bulb went on, and the only thing left standing were stone buildings.
sentences.zh: 人们终于开窍了，因为唯一屹立不倒的只有石质建筑。

sentences.en: And so the whole technology changed,
sentences.zh: 于是整个建造技术发生了改变，

sentences.en: and people started building with native stone.
sentences.zh: 人们开始用当地的石头进行建造。

sentences.en: And so stone became a critical part of the island's vernacular.
sentences.zh: 因此，石头成为了岛屿本土建筑中至关重要的一部分。

sentences.en: It made for robust walls, and it made use of this plentiful local material.
sentences.zh: 它造就了坚固的墙壁，并充分利用了这种随处可得的本地材料。

sentences.en: And these stone walls were in turn topped with heavy stone roofs,
sentences.zh: 这些石墙上面又盖上了沉重的石制屋顶，

sentences.en: which have a noticeably steep slope.
A slope which serves a vital function in a hurricane.
sentences.zh: 这种坡度在飓风中起着至关重要的作用。

sentences.en: It turns out that a shallow roof can really suck during a tropical storm.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，在热带风暴中，平缓的屋顶真的很糟糕。

sentences.en: While a steep roof, well, I'll just let Colin explain it.
sentences.zh: 而陡峭的屋顶嘛，我还是让科林来解释吧。

sentences.en: It doesn't suffer suction, which is the big problem in a hurricane.
sentences.zh: 它不会遭受吸力的破坏，而这正是飓风中的大问题。

sentences.en: As the wind goes rushing over a roof,
if the roof has a lower pitch, it acts as a wing, and you have lift.
sentences.zh: 如果屋顶的坡度较缓，它就会像机翼一样产生升力。

sentences.en: And many buildings are torn apart, not by the wind pushing it,
sentences.zh: 许多建筑物被撕裂，不是因为风在推它们，

sentences.en: but the suction forces that collect on the other side of the roof.
sentences.zh: 而是因为屋顶另一侧聚集的吸力造成的。

sentences.en: So these slightly higher-pitched roofs here in Bermuda
sentences.zh: 因此，百慕大这些坡度稍陡的屋顶

sentences.en: also act to create enough turbulence that they break the suction forces,
sentences.zh: 还能起到产生足够湍流的作用，从而打破吸力，

sentences.en: So the roof pitch helps, but the most distinctive part of these rooftops,
sentences.zh: 所以屋顶的坡度有帮助，但从视觉上看，这些屋顶最独特的特征

sentences.en: It's the way overlapping stone slats make the sides of each roof
sentences.zh: 而是重叠的石板让每个屋顶的两侧

sentences.en: look like a bright white staircase.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像亮白色的阶梯。

sentences.en: And this style of Bermuda roof serves a purpose
sentences.zh: 这种风格的百慕大屋顶具有一种特定用途，

sentences.en: related to another feature of the island's climate.
sentences.zh: 与该岛气候的另一个特点息息相关。

sentences.en: And what this does is it slows the water down.
sentences.zh: 这样做可以使水流速度变慢。

sentences.en: As the water hits the roof,
instead of going rushing down on a flat plain surface,
sentences.zh: 它不会顺着平坦的表面急流直下，

sentences.en: it has to go down a step.
sentences.zh: 而是必须一级一级往下流。

sentences.en: So while the overall pitch of the roof is steep,
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然屋顶的整体坡度很陡，

sentences.en: that's offset by this staircase shape,
sentences.zh: 但这种阶梯形状恰好抵消了这一影响，

sentences.en: which keeps water from running down and off the sides too quickly.
sentences.zh: 从而防止雨水从两侧过快地流走。

sentences.en: Almost like a little river going through pebbles in the lake.
sentences.zh: 就像湖里穿过卵石的小溪一样。

sentences.en: So it slows the water down so you can capture the water at the gutter level,
sentences.zh: 因此它能减缓水流速度，以便你能在排水沟的高度收集雨水，

sentences.en: and you're not losing it over the edge of the eaves.
sentences.zh: 而不会让水从屋檐边缘流失。

sentences.en: Catching water has been an essential function of houses in Bermuda
sentences.zh: 几乎从一开始，收集雨水就一直是百慕大房屋的一项基本功能。
这非常重要，因为这些房屋没有水井

And this got started in 1612 or thereabouts,
